'''AJ Delisle''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[RamapoCon III]] on 8 June 2001 with Speedy Dark Deal, according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2478">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-18-ramapo3-8-10-jun-00d2478/ ramapo3-8-10-jun-00], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 18 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-18-ramapo3-8-10-jun-00d2478/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
